Summer Intern(Tektork private limited, Coimbatore) – Embedded Systems and IoT 2026 
Currently pursuing a Summer Internship at Tektork Private Limited, gaining advanced knowledge in Embedded Systems and 
IoT technologies. Acquired hands-on experience in sensor and actuator interfacing, ESP32 programming, Wi -Fi and cloud 
connectivity and developing IoT applications using platforms such as Arduino IoT Cloud, Blynk IoT, Ubidots and Node -RED. 
Also gained practical exposure to IoT dashboard creation, embedded system fundamentals and real -world industrial 
applications of IoT solutions. 
Winter Intern(NIELIT, Calicut) – Embedded Systems and IoT 2025 
Completed an internship in Embedded Systems and IoT, gaining practica l experience in microcontroller programming and 
real-time embedded application development. Worked with Embedded C, Arduino and ESP32 platforms, developed IoT-based 
monitoring systems using Adafruit IO and gained hands-on experience in sensor interfacing, circuit integration, data handling, 
system testing and troubleshooting. 
 
 AI Sign Language Translator | Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, Tkinter, Pygame : 2026 
Developed a real -time AI -based sign language translator capable of recognizing 17 custom hand gestures using 
MediaPipe and OpenCV. Implemented finger -state analysis and landmark -based gesture recognition with voice output 
and an interactive Tkinter GUI. 
Microplastics Detection in Water | ESP32-CAM, Python, OpenCV : 2026 
Developed a computer vision -based system to analyze water samples and estimate microplastic -like particles.Integrated 
ESP32-CAM for wireless image capture and implemente d contour-based particle detection using OpenCV.Utilized WiFi/IP 
communication for real-time image acquisition and processing. 
Smart Irrigation System and Plant Disease Detection : 2025 
Developed an IoT -based smart agriculture system using ESP32, soil mois ture sensor and DHT11 sensor to monitor soil 
and environmental conditions. Integrated automated irrigation control and AI -powered plant disease detection using 
image processing to support timely crop management and improve agricultural productivity. 
Missile Defense Radar System : 2025 
Developed a simulated missile defense radar system using Arduino, ultrasonic sensors, and a servo motor for real -time 
object detection and distance measurement (0 –400 cm) . Implemented Java -based control logic and visual alerts for 
reliable target tracking.
